passage.title: Model paragraph written for TGA
paras: Both Dharker and Alareer present hope as something that arrives in hardship. [Point] Dharker's water is 'the voice of a kindly god', [Evidence] a religious metaphor [Method] that makes a burst pipe feel like mercy, whereas Alareer's repeated plea 'let it bring hope' [Evidence] makes hope a gift the speaker hands on. [Analysis] Perhaps Dharker is also angry that water must be a miracle at all. [Alternative] Writing from Mumbai and from Gaza, [Context] both poets show that hope is strongest where it is hardest to find. [Significance]

questions.q: From your feedback, write your strongest and weakest strand
Core: DIRT in the portal response box. Rewrite your weakest comparative paragraph from sitting 1 using the model. Starter: 'Both poets...'
questions.a: An improved integrated paragraph with both poems, embedded quotations and a significance sentence.

questions.q: Extend: write your target for the end-of-year test

Which change would most improve a paragraph that only analyses one poem?
options: add a longer quotation from the first poem
add a comparative sentence with evidence from the second poem
questions.a: C) add a comparative sentence with evidence from the second poem. Comparison needs both poems in the paragraph.
